transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, my regular doctor actually wanted me to come in. He says I've gotten too thin lately. I mean, I guess I can see it a bit—my work pants are hanging pretty loose on me when I'm on my shift. But... honestly, part of me still feels relieved when I see the number on the scale go down.
How do you feel about the possibility of gaining weight?

Honestly, it scares me. Just the thought of it. If I eat something heavier... like some biscuits or a bit of pasta... I spend the rest of the day just scared that it's going to show on me right away. I end up keeping on checking myself, and I just can't stop thinking that I need to make up for it somehow. So yeah, the idea of actually gaining weight is really hard for me to stomach.
Have you had episodes where you feel unable to control how much you eat?

No, I haven't really experienced that. I... well, I don't ever feel out of control with my eating. If anything, it's the exact opposite. I keep a very strict eye on every little thing I eat, so I don't ever have times where I just keep eating and can't stop.
Has a healthcare professional told you that your current weight is significantly below what is healthy or expected for you?

Yes, like I mentioned when we first sat down, my regular doctor is the one who sent me here because of that. He told me I've gotten too thin and that it isn't healthy for me. I mean, I can see what he's talking about—my work pants are practically falling off me when I'm cleaning the building. But even knowing he's concerned... I still just feel relieved when that number on the scale goes down instead of up.
Do you deliberately restrict how much you eat or skip meals in order to prevent yourself from gaining weight?

Yes, I do. I mean, I make full meals for my husband and my mother-in-law... I'll cook up a whole plate for them. But by the time I sit down at the table, I usually just tell myself that a cup of coffee, maybe a few vegetables, or just half a piece of toast is enough for me. So, yes, I definitely hold back on what I actually eat.
